env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds and deploys a delta on the current `search` developer profile for both RT-CV detection and RT-Embed embeddings. Detection events flow through `mdx-raw`; embeddings flow through `mdx-embed` to Search behavior analytics and `mdx-embed-filtered` before Elasticsearch. The build label is directory metadata only.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build and deploy under `_builds/in-3-runtime/`: "Provide live and on-demand VIOS ingestion, per-frame RT-DETR detection and tracking with RT-CV, and video/frame embeddings with RT-Embed. Keep media retrievable. Publish and index both metadata streams." Target `{{platform}}`; retain `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, set the embedding input topic to `mdx-embed`, exclude Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, Search query API, RT-VLM, and LLM NIMs, validate before deployment, prove both live and upload paths, and leave services running.
checks: `_builds/in-3-runtime/override.env` exists with `FOUNDATION=search`, a full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only customized environment values.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`; explicitly excluded keys, including `rtvi-vlm`, are absent.
`RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` is effective and Behavior Analytics is selected as the producer of `mdx-embed-filtered`.
`ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is effective because VLM critique was excluded.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no build label, aggregate profile, or invented service key.

`_builds/in-3-runtime/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, `patches/` is absent, and the build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) with no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Four-layer resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and the build `override.env` with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, all selected keys resolve, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real `${...}` interpolation remains unresolved, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.
Deployment uses exactly `_builds/in-3-runtime/resolved.yml` without re-reading Foundation env files or supplying a profile flag.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200, and RT-Embed readiness responds successfully.
An uploaded video remains retrievable through VIOS and produces both RT-CV and RT-Embed output.
A live NvStreamer source is registered through VIOS and both RT-CV and RT-Embed are driven from the runtime-discovered VIOS live-proxy URL.
Kafka end offsets for `mdx-raw`, `mdx-embed`, and `mdx-embed-filtered` are recorded before and after processing; all three increase.
Elasticsearch contains both detection documents and embedding documents attributable to the processed media.
No duplicate Kafka or Elasticsearch stack is deployed.
No file under `deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Foundation, delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka offsets, and Elasticsearch evidence.
